content: For the philosopher and sociologist Jacques Ellul, however, in a society with mass communication, propaganda is inevitable and thus it is necessary to become more aware of it BIBREF3; but whether or not to classify a given strip of text as propaganda depends not just on its content but on its use on the part of both addressers and addressees BIBREF1, and this fact makes the automated detection of propaganda intrinsically challenging.
